sources.articleTitle: ‘We’ll beat DR Congo all-round’ – Olympic Eagles stars promise ahead of LA 2028 Qualifier

headline: Olympic Eagles Prepare For LA 2028 Olympic Qualifying Matchup
metaDescription: The Nigerian Olympic Eagles are preparing for an away qualifying match against the DR Congo ahead of the 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles.
aiSummaryBullets: The Nigerian under-23 national football team is preparing to face DR Congo in an Olympic qualifier.
Players expressed confidence in achieving a positive result during the first leg of the competition.
The match serves as a qualifying stage for the upcoming Olympic Games scheduled for 2028 in Los Angeles.
aiContextParagraph: The Nigerian under-23 national football team, known as the Olympic Eagles, is currently gearing up for a crucial qualifying fixture against the DR Congo. This match is part of the qualification process for the 2028 Olympic Games, which are set to take place in Los Angeles. Despite the logistical challenge of traveling for an away game, the team members have publicly stated their intention to secure a favorable result during this initial encounter. Following the first leg of the tie, the teams will face off again for a decisive second leg to determine which squad progresses further in the tournament. These qualifiers represent a significant milestone for the young players as they aim to represent their country on the international stage at the quadrennial multi-sport event in the United States.
whyItIsViral: The story has generated moderate public search interest in Nigeria regarding Olympic football qualifying fixtures and team performance.
